summary: Refresh the responsive agent sidebar against the native two-line row and inspector behavior. Context remains in the row popover only; remove the status ring, unused Layout C metrics and their extension API. Exercise production sidebar drag cleanup at a declared 1100px browser viewport and retain stale decode notices in every sidebar host.

schema.detail: No storage or wire schema changes.

compatibility.detail: Main public extension APIs and native row behavior are retained. The unmerged Layout C spend extension requirement is removed.

downtime.detail: No downtime; reload the web application.

recovery.detail: Revert the web build; no persistent state repair is required.
